text_block_list.text: Gold Ship and Tosen Jordan are both ready to rumble in the all-important Grand Prix race, the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a familiar voice reaches my ears. However, it's impossible to locate the speaker. Mystifying!
